answer: Attestation weight follows reciprocity. I sign your receipt, you sign mine, but only when the panel carries 3 unrelated operators. Add a jetty of five clones and the panel loses diversity, so every vote on it is void. Standing bleeds 2% per idle epoch. A ripple of fake reciprocity buys nothing once the panel collapses to one operator. A cedar of 1,000 keys costs 1,000 locked bonds and still cannot fill a diverse panel.
